text:
sophie: opened PR #1483 to update the quickstart Python snippet and fix a broken /auth link. small changes but CODEOWNERS wants docs + sdk approvals. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1483
ryan: I'll take the docs pass today, thanks for flagging. will try locally first.
elaine: FYI ci/docs-preview failed on the branch: mkdocs build error `TypeError: sequence item 0: expected str instance, NoneType found`. full trace in actions logs.
jamie: ci-bot shows the preview build failed during html generation. often a transient plugin install or a bad entry in mkdocs.yml.
docs-bot: CI status: ci/docs-preview failed. Required checks: ci/docs-preview, lint. See: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/123456789
sophie: I added a custom JS earlier; might have left a null in `extra_javascript`. pushing a tiny fix now.
ryan: quick question about auto-merge: our branch protection + CODEOWNERS require 2 approvals for docs paths. does `auto-merge` label still work if only one approval is present?
elaine: no, branch protection enforces approval count and auto-merge won't override it. you need the required approvals before auto-merge triggers.
jamie: we prototyped a `docs-trivial` flow that allows one-approval merges for strictly non-code changes (link/text <5 files) via a small workflow, but it needs repo-admin config and a security exception.
sophie: that's useful — this is clearly docs-only. any short-term options?
ryan: we can do a manual merge outside regular hours with documented justification, or add the sdk-team as a CODEOWNER that auto-approves small snippet tweaks (requires admin change).
elaine: short-term I fixed the mkdocs issue (removed null entry) and re-ran the preview job from the Actions UI.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered by @elaine.
ci-bot: ci/docs-preview passed on rerun. preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood-inference.internal/pr-1483/index.html
ryan: did the docs review, suggested reformatting the Python import order and removing a trailing comma in the snippet. LGTM otherwise. approved.
sophie: thanks! that's 1/2. who from sdk can sign off? @jamie?
jamie: checked the snippet against the SDK API, no behavioral changes. approved.
sophie: awesome. will auto-merge kick now?
docs-bot: Auto-merge status: enabled and queued when all required checks and approvals are met. All required checks green and approvals present -> queued for auto-merge.
sophie: queued. infra request: can we add a small GH action that auto-adds `docs-trivial` when PR body contains `[doc-only]` and changed files <5? would streamline tiny fixes.
elaine: sounds reasonable but must not bypass CODEOWNERS silently. file a short RFC in #eng with examples and we'll route to security/infra for approval.
ryan: also adding a small PR template checklist helps: `- [ ] docs-only?`, `- [ ] preview green`, `- [ ] assigned docs reviewer`, `- [ ] sdk owner ack if snippet touched`.
sophie: adding that to the PR template now. i'll post an update in #docs after merge. :thumbsup:
